acceptanceCriteria: Recognizably belongs to the Fungalfolk family and preserves every identity invariant.
Reads specifically as Mycon, T2, rather than another family form.
Communicates the Gill-Club Soldier (Soldier) archetype and its battlefield duty.
Preserves coherent load-bearing anatomy, complete limbs, and believable ground contact.
Uses at least two normal construction dimensions without a palette-only or glow-only treatment.
Keeps the attack telegraph and counterplay signal visible at gameplay scale.
Frames one complete featured subject with no crop, labels, UI text, or watermark.
Output remains a candidate until independent approved-review evidence exists; it is never a runtime asset.
anatomyInvariants: Human-sized spotted cap, first faint cyan gill glow, and a club made from hardened stalk.
Signature mechanic: Gill Beat: the spotted cap lifts, faint cyan gills inhale, and the hardened stalk club swings once before exhale.
battlefieldDuty: Repeat close pressure with a hardened stalk club and a readable gill-lit recovery.
constructionDimensions: Family-native, non-affinity bioluminescent glow, spores, mycelium, and damp habitat remain fungal biology or environment, not elemental glow, Wind, Water, or any other affinity.
Cap tissue, gills, stalk fiber, ordinary spore drift, damp reflection, moss, and visible mycelial threads remain restrained and source-bound.
counterplay: Cross under the cap during inhale and punish the club-side stalk on exhale. Affinity signal: The established planted stalk, gill pause, spore intake gap, secondary mushroom stem, or throne-network node remains readable.
forbiddenTreatments: Treating native spores, dampness, or bioluminescence as affinity evidence
identityInvariants: Cap-headed, stalk-bodied silhouette with gills, bulbous limbs, and a wider top than base remains recognizable.
Pale fungal flesh and one strong cap tone contrast with bounded cyan or green gill bioluminescence from T2 onward.
Fungal flesh, spongy cap, mycelium, damp moss, and spore dust remain organic and spatially coherent.
Cap breadth, gill light, spore density, secondary growth, and ground mycelium escalate at explicit source tiers.
telegraph: Faint gill light gathers while the human-sized stalk draws the club behind its body.
